name: SEOAgent
tagline: The SEO engine for coding agents
description: SEOAgent gives Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex the tools to grow organic traffic without publishing AI slop. The free Skill audits the site and builds or improves SEO pages in the repo; optional Autopilot cloud uses Google Search Console plus keyword research and queues updates you approve.

install.notes: Or: npm install -g @seoagent-official/seoagent && seoagent init. Claude plugin: /plugin marketplace add Baxter-Inc/seoagent-npm then /plugin install seoagent-cli-bootstrap@seoagent-official
